column1: # Command policy shared by `devops ssh -- <cmd>`, `devops deploy` steps and
# tools/agents/guard.sh (harness hooks). It labels commands for the audit log;
# only tier 3 (an on-chain transaction) asks the user, and only class S is refused.
# Columns (tab-separated):
#   tier   kind   pattern   reason
# kind "re"  : Python regex searched in the whole command; the highest matching tier wins.
# kind "cmd" : read-only allowlist prefix. A command is tier 0 only when EVERY
#              segment (split on ; && || | and newlines) starts with an allowlisted prefix.
# kind "secret": the command would print secret material; refused.
# Anything else defaults to tier 2 (may change something; it runs and is logged).
# Built into classify.py: `docker exec <c> <cmd>` is judged by <cmd>, and psql is
# tier 0 only with PGOPTIONS default_transaction_read_only=on (a SELECT can write
# through a function). Prefer `devops debug pg`, which always sets it.
# git: only -C <path>, -c safe.directory=<path> and --no-pager may precede the
# subcommand; any other git option makes the segment tier 2.
# --- refused: prints secret material ---
